title: Color-Burn
description: A game in which you must collect each color in a bottle.

title: Link IE
description: A platform to create redirect links, particularly for the IsenEngineering association.

title: Kernel-Panic
description: An 'Escape Game' hackathon where participants must solve challenges & puzzles. They all have the same environment and compete with a real-time leaderboard.

title: La Bourse Folle
description: A stock exchange-type platform in which drink prices fluctuate based on consumption (during IsenEngineering association events).

title: Neon-Dawn
description: A hackathon in which you must put a satellite into orbit with code.

title: All Game Long - Bet
description: A platform that allows you to bet fictional sums during an event at a competitive evening. Who will have the most money at the end of the evening?

title: Tidee
description: A platform for managing attendance and members of the IsenEngineering association. It allows measuring responsible engagement in hours.
